ocl.definition: cashDesks:Set(CashDesk) = CashDesk.allInstance(), targetCashDesk:CashDesk = cashDesks->any(o | o.Id = id)
ocl.postcondition: let cashDesk:CashDesk = cashDesks->any(o | o.Id = id) in (cashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = true and result = false) or (cashDesk.oclIsUndefined() = false and cashDesk.Name = name and cashDesk.IsOpened = isopened and result = true)
